modules.title: Introduction to Marriage and Family in Islam
modules.html:
Marriage, the rights of spouses and children, divorce and inheritance under Islamic law. This section covers introduction to marriage and family in islam.

Key points

  • Marriage in Islam is: — Nikah.
  • The term 'Tawhid' in Islam refers to the _____. — Oneness of Allah.
  • The first Mu'adhin (caller to prayer) in Islam was _____. — Bilal b. Rabah.
  • Which Caliph oversaw the expansion of Islam into Persia and Egypt — Umar b. Khattab.
  • First Pillar of Islam: — Shahada.

Worked examples

Q: Marriage in Islam is:
A: Nikah — Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Nikah.

Q: The term 'Tawhid' in Islam refers to the _____.
A: Oneness of Allah — Tawhid is the core concept of monotheism in Islam, asserting that Allah is One and Unique in His essence and attributes.

quiz.q: Marriage in Islam is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Nikah.

quiz.q: The term 'Tawhid' in Islam refers to the _____.
quiz.solution: Tawhid is the core concept of monotheism in Islam, asserting that Allah is One and Unique in His essence and attributes.

quiz.q: The first Mu'adhin (caller to prayer) in Islam was _____.
quiz.solution: Bilal, a former slave from Ethiopia, was chosen for his beautiful and strong voice to call Muslims to prayer.

quiz.q: Which Caliph oversaw the expansion of Islam into Persia and Egypt?
quiz.solution: Umar (RA) was the great administrator and conqueror under whose rule the Islamic empire expanded most rapidly.

quiz.q: First Pillar of Islam:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Shahada.

quiz.q: The literal meaning of 'Islam' is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Submission/Peace.

quiz.q: Fasting in Ramadan is the _____ Pillar of Islam.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Fourth.

quiz.q: The uncle of the Prophet who supported him but did not accept Islam was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Abu Talib.

quiz.q: Divorce in Islam is called:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Talaq.

quiz.q: The first Muezzin of Islam was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Bilal ibn Rabah.

quiz.q: Fasting (Sawm) during the month of Ramadan is the ___ pillar of Islam.
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Fourth.

quiz.q: The term for 'lawful' actions or food in Islam is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Halal.

quiz.q: First martyr in Islam:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Sumayyah.

quiz.q: Fasting is the ___ pillar of Islam?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 4th.

quiz.q: The first man to accept Islam was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Abu Bakr.

quiz.q: The first major battle in Islam was the Battle of?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Badr.

quiz.q: Riba is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Interest/Usury.

quiz.q: The battle of Badr took place in the year:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 2 AH.

quiz.q: Shirk means:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Associating partners with Allah.

quiz.q: The holy book revealed to Prophet Dawud (David) is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Zabur.

quiz.q: Surah Al-Fatihah is known as:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: The Opening.

quiz.q: The night of power is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Laylat al-Qadr.

quiz.q: Jinn are created from:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Smokeless Fire.

quiz.q: The Kalimah (Shahada) is the:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: First pillar.

quiz.q: Which category of people are NOT eligible to receive Zakat?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: The wealthy.

quiz.q: The major sin that is unforgivable if a person dies without repenting is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Shirk.

quiz.q: The battle of Badr took place in year:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: 2 AH.

quiz.q: Which prayer has no Ruku or Sujud?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Janazah (Funeral) Prayer.

quiz.q: The waiting period for a divorced woman is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Iddah.

quiz.q: Tawaf is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Circumambulation of Kaaba.

quiz.q: Compilation of Quran under:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Abu Bakr/Uthman.

quiz.q: Iddah is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Waiting period.

quiz.q: Uhud defeat cause:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Archers left post.

quiz.q: Salat times:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: 5.

quiz.q: 2nd Caliph:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Umar.

quiz.q: Waiting:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Iddah.

quiz.q: Kafir:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Disbeliever.

quiz.q: How many times is Salat performed daily?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Five.

quiz.q: Which of these is a recipient of Zakat?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: The poor (Al-Fuqara).

quiz.q: The stoning of the devil (Shaitan) is called?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Rami al-Jimar.

quiz.q: Madinan Surahs generally deal with?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Legislation and Social life.

quiz.q: Al-Isra' wal-Mi'raj refers to the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Night Journey and Ascension.

quiz.q: The first Caliph (Khalifah) after the Prophet was?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Abu Bakr.
